messages.content: Chargeback mane customer tar bank-ke bole j ekta transaction unauthorized ba problem thake, ar bank shei taka merchant theke ferot niye customer-ke diye dey.
Simple bhabe: customer bank-e giye bole 'eta amar na', ar bank taka ferot niye nei. Eta seller-er jonno kharap, karon taka ar content dutoi hariye jai.
